title: H-CARBUYSTACK-1 (option B + amendments): a car bought at a dealership whose delivery spot holds a PARTNER's car (a ghost - not in the buyer's save list, so the native 6 m check never saw it) lands on a free spot next to it instead of inside it; the buyer's OWN car on the spot still gets the native refusal (single-player parity), no money taken. Host buys first (spot free -> native spawn on the spot), the client then buys the same model in the same store (host ghost on the spot -> chosen spot 2.5..12 m away, '[CarBuy] ... chose'), the host buys again (its own car on the spot -> native refusal, money unchanged), and the host sees the client's new car ghost at the chosen spot with no two cars within 2 m.
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, Client1; both spawn outdoors near (65, -194)). Dev build with 'buycar <vehicleTypeId|auto> [color]' (auto = the cheapest showroom car in the scene; reply 'OK buycar <id> result=<bool> vid=<new|-> pos=<x,y,z> spotd=<m from the delivery spot> money=<before>-><after> showroom=<bool>') and 'carspot' ('OK carspot spot=<pos> own=[id@d,...] ghosts=[vid@d,...] minpair=<closest pair m>'). vars.store = City Cars (context log 2026-06-14: '76 ba:street_thirdstreet' = the 'City Cars' car dealership). 'spend -N' earns N through the game's own money path so both can afford the car. A side candidate (right/left 1) sits W+0.8 m (~2.8 m) from the spot, so the chosen-spot distance window is 2.5..12 m (the 12 m hard cap).

steps.note: baseline: what is around the delivery spot before any purchase
spot free for everyone -> the native spawn ON the delivery spot
the host's fleet reaches the client; the client spawns the ghost
PREMISE: the host's new car is a ghost on the client, ON the delivery spot (registry read - it may be hidden indoors)

expect_log.regex: \[CarBuy\] spot blocked by partner ghost \S+ \(${hostPid}\) at .*; chose .* d=\d+\.\d\d tried=\d+

steps.note: THE FIX: the partner's car on the spot -> a free spot next to it (2.5..12 m), not inside the host's car
the client's fleet reaches the host; the host spawns the new ghost

expect_log.regex: \[CarBuy\] own car \S+ on the spot - native refusal \(parity\)

steps.note: PARITY: the host's OWN car on the spot -> the native refusal, no money taken
the host sees the client's new car at the chosen spot; no two cars around the spot within 2 m
report only: the client's view after both purchases
